title: Grid and arena check of the predator-turnover swings: at 1.5x resolution (192^2, dx 2/3, same box) and in a 2.25x larger arena (192^2, dx 1) the neutral two-kind predator-prey system swings with the same timing as at 128^2 (prey troughs t~4200-6100 and ~12200-13800, peak t~9100-9400)
summary: world2g.py of 20261027T0557-c52-predator-turnover-cycles-selection with its dx parameter (inherited from the claim world: wavenumbers, noise length and taxis flux scaled), neutral arm (both kinds hunt; yg 0.5, kdec 5e-4, mconv 1e-3), seed 0, t=16000, mdrive.py with SIZE 192. Prey bodies every 1000 t from t=2000: 128^2 dx 1 (from 20261027T0637-c52-turnover-cycles-three-seeds) 43, 19, 5, 3, 2, 8, 18, 29, 29, 14, 7, 4, 8, 16, 28; 192^2 dx 2/3 39, 17, 7, 3, 1, 5, 20, 31, 25, 19, 4, 5, 5, 11, 28; 192^2 dx 1 (2.25x area) 96, 28, 8, 12, 8, 12, 49, 72, 41, 25, 5, 9, 30, 34, 58. Smoothed troughs: 5500/12700, 6000/13800, 4200-5800/12200; peaks 7800-9400, 9400, 9100. e/b stays 0.99 and 0.99. Together with the three seeds of 20261027T0637-c52-turnover-cycles-three-seeds, the swings meet the rubric's oscillation check (peak spacing on 3 seeds plus a grid check) at the level of two troughs per run.

finding.control: 1.5x resolution at the same box; 2.25x arena

limits: One seed per variant, about two troughs per run (t=16000); a longer run would give a period distribution. Drive-style counts, no labkit packs. In the larger arena the prey never fall below 5 bodies, so the swing is less deep.
